sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: This page describes how Aurelis collects, uses and protects the personal information of people who visit this website or place an order with us. Aurelis is based in Qatar, and we handle personal data in line with Qatar's Personal Data Privacy Protection Law (Law No. 13 of 2016).

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: When you place an order, we collect your name, phone number, delivery address, order details (including any customization choices, and the recipient/sender names and message text you write for personalized letters), and, if you choose to provide it, your email address and order notes. We do not collect or store any payment card details, since all orders are paid in cash on delivery.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect only to confirm, prepare, and deliver your order, contact you about your order by phone or email, and respond to questions you send us. We do not use your information for marketing unless you separately ask us to.

sections.heading: Cookies and Website Analytics
sections.body: This website does not currently use cookies, and we do not run any analytics or advertising tracking on it. Loading this site does make a request to Google Fonts to display our website fonts, which may share your device's IP address with Google as part of that request. If we introduce cookies or analytics tools in the future, we will update this policy and, where required, ask for your consent first.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We use EmailJS, a third-party email delivery service, to send order confirmations; your order and contact details pass through EmailJS's systems for this purpose only. We do not sell your personal information, and we do not share it with anyone else except where needed to fulfil your order (for example, a delivery courier) or where required by Qatari law.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We keep order and customer records for as long as needed to fulfil your order and to meet our accounting and legal obligations, and delete them when they are no longer needed for those purposes.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: Under Qatar's Personal Data Privacy Protection Law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of the personal information we hold about you by contacting us at aurelis2058@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: This website is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this policy, please contact us at aurelis2058@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: These terms govern your use of this website and any purchase you make from Aurelis. By placing an order, you agree to the terms described on this page.

sections.heading: Products and Availability
sections.body: Because our items are handmade, small variations in color, size and texture may occur between the product photos and the item you receive. Product availability may change without notice.

sections.heading: Custom Orders
sections.body: Custom and made to order items, including personalized letters and custom color combinations, are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged unless the item arrives defective or damaged. Production timelines are estimates and are not guaranteed.

sections.heading: Pricing and Payment
sections.body: All prices are listed in Qatari Riyals (QAR). Payment is cash on delivery, collected when your order is handed to you. We reserve the right to correct any pricing errors shown on the site, and will confirm final pricing with you by phone before your order ships.

sections.heading: Order Confirmation and Delivery
sections.body: After you submit an order, we will contact you by phone to confirm the details and give you an estimated delivery date. Delivery is currently by local meet-up within Qatar; no shipping carrier is used. Aurelis is not responsible for delays caused by circumstances outside our control.

sections.heading: Returns and Exchanges
sections.body: Ready-made items may be returned or exchanged within 3 days of delivery if unused and in their original condition; contact us at aurelis2058@gmail.com to arrange this. Custom and made-to-order items (see 'Custom Orders' above) are not eligible for return or exchange unless defective or damaged on arrival.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All designs, photographs, illustrations and written content on this website are the property of Aurelis and may not be copied or reused without written permission.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: This website and its products are provided as is. Aurelis is not liable for any indirect or incidental damages arising from the use of this site or its products, beyond the purchase price paid.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Qatar.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of this website after changes are posted means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about these terms, please contact us at aurelis2058@gmail.com.
